description: KFLT v1 frozen golden vector for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. UNSIGNED serializeFilter output (signer[32,64) + sig[64,128) regions are zero — Schnorr signing is non-deterministic and has its own tests). Determinism via padToBucket:false (no random decoys). Cross-impl / future-Rust-port contract: rebuilding the Binary Fuse 16 filter from memberKeysHex + opts and serializing MUST reproduce serializedBlobHex byte-for-byte, and the membership results MUST match. NOTE: memberKeysHex INTENTIONALLY includes two 66-char (33-byte) keys — the build/serialize layer hashes arbitrary-length hex (buildMembershipFilter has no length guard), and they are part of the frozen serialization. membership.present/absent are restricted to 64-hex values because testMembership() validates 64-hex at its public boundary; the two non-64-hex members are still IN the filter (and in serializedBlobHex), they are simply not probed via the now-hardened testMembership API.
